+Issue: When classes had __orig_bases__ explicitly set to None, the _get_bases function
+       would return None, causing a "TypeError: 'NoneType' object is not iterable"
+       during unpickling.
+
+Solution: Modified _get_bases function in cloudpickle.py to fallback to __bases__
+          when getattr(typ, bases_attr) returns None.
+
+Changes made:
+  - Added null check in _get_bases function
+  - Added fallback to __bases__ when bases is None
